report.summary: Recognizable and charming caricature: the broad low hipped roof, warm tan walls with dark trim, centered gabled vestibule, and small red-and-pale rooftop feature closely match the clearest street view. No duplicated principal portal or major visible modeling defect is evident.

orientation.summary: The located SV3 camera looks NNE directly toward the +v face and clearly shows the centered principal entrance beneath the small gable and rooftop feature. The labeled +v render reproduces that composition, and the door inventory confirms one double door only on +v, outward SSW toward Northwest Highway. SV1/SV2 are heavily screened, while SV4 is off-axis and geometrically faces -u, so they do not contradict this placement.

issues.problem: The labeled -u panel is blocked by a neighboring two-story building and does not visibly document the target rear face.
issues.fix: Re-render the -u validation view from a closer or elevated unobstructed camera aimed at the target.
